test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **Delicious.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct spelling** and **meaning of the marked option** are as follows:
 
• Spelling: **Delicious **
 
• Meaning: **highly pleasant to the taste**
 
 
• ***Example***: *My mother cooks **delicious** food for me. *
 
 
 
• Hence the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meanings** of other given **options:**

 
 
• **Anxious**: fearful, worried.
 
• **Famous: **well-known.
 
• **Enormous: **vast, huge.
